span.p:
🔑 SSH keys · cloud creds · browser profiles
+ everything else on your machine

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
🤖 Claude Code CLI
unprivileged 'node' user · capabilities dropped
no-new-privileges · memory / PID limits

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
📂 /workspace
= your project folder — the only part of
your machine mounted in

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
🚦 Allowlist egress proxy — decides allow / deny by hostname
Run ONE mode:
Default: hostname filter (tinyproxy)
Opt-in: TLS-intercept + content rules (mitmproxy)

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
🧱 Kernel firewall — FAIL-CLOSED
only the proxy's traffic may exit (service-account gate)
agent's direct DNS · IPv6 · private and cloud-metadata blocked

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
✅ Approved hosts
Anthropic / Claude · npm · GitHub (on by default, removable)
+ approved extras

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
⛔ Unapproved hosts
blocked (no direct path out)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
🔍 Content-mediation mode (opt-in) adds:
• GitHub read-only (clone yes, push no) · block file-upload endpoint
• strip stray API keys (optional strict token pin)
• reject Host / TLS-SNI outside the allowlist (no fronting)
• every decision logged (persisted)

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠️ Honest boundary: your project content IS sent to Anthropic for inference (by design).
Approved hosts are trust grants — keep the allowlist minimal. The login token is stored
and readable inside the sandbox. Strong container isolation, not a full VM boundary.
Default mode matches the requested hostname (a shared-CDN host could be domain-fronted);
the opt-in TLS mode closes that by checking the inner Host / TLS-SNI.
